name: one-shot-ai-panel
description: OneShotAiPanel package manifest: required UI primitives, runtime dependencies and integration modes (GitHub dependency / CLI installer / source copy). The panel primitives are base-ui based.

modes.github: pnpm add github:bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel — compiled package (dist, committed to the repo; bundles its own base-ui primitives). Recommended when the host already has radix/shadcn components. Requires a shadcn theme (CSS tokens) + tailwind v4 + tw-animate-css; add an @source directive in globals.css so Tailwind scans the package.
modes.cli: pnpm exec one-shot-ai-panel install (or: node <clone>/scripts/install.mjs <project>) — copies the module source + its base-ui primitives into the host project (src/external-modules/ai-panel). Only for fresh projects without existing radix components (overwrites shared ui/* names with --force).
modes.copy: Copy src/module into your project then install the primitives listed below (shadcn philosophy: you own the source code). Same base-ui caveat as the CLI installer.
